questions.prompt: How many total kilograms of raw apples are harvested across all orchards in New Zealand in a single year?
reasoning: New Zealand produces around 550 thousand tonnes of apples annually
One tonne is equal to 1,000 kilograms
Multiplying 550,000 tonnes by 1,000 gives 550 million kilograms

questions.prompt: How many total individual standard wooden matches are contained within all matchbooks produced globally by manufacturing companies in a single year?
reasoning: Estimate that about 15 billion matchbooks or boxes are produced worldwide annually
Assuming an average of 8 matches per matchbook or box
15 billion multiplied by 8 yields 120 billion matches

questions.prompt: How many total minutes do all active commercial freight trains operating across the rail network of India run collectively in a single day?
reasoning: There are approximately 10,000 freight trains running daily on the Indian Railways network
Each freight train operates for an average of 24 hours per day
Converting 24 hours to minutes gives 1,440 minutes per train per day
Multiplying 10,000 trains by 1,440 minutes results in 14.4 million total minutes
